workoutPlan.rawText:
Use your same 8-week structure

Weeks 1–6: Progressive overload
Weeks 7–8: Deload (−40–50% load or half sets, higher reps)

--------------------------------------------------

DAY 1 – BACK + BICEPS (V-TAPER FOCUSED)

Warm-up / Activation
- Cat–Cow + World’s Greatest Stretch → 2 rounds
- Band Pull-Apart → 2 × 20
- Dead Hang → 2 × 30 sec

Activation (DO NOT SKIP)
- Straight Arm Pulldown → 2–3 × 12–15 (light weight, focus on lats)

---

BACK (Main Workout)
1. Pull-Ups / Assisted Pull-Ups
   → 3 × 6–10
2. Lat Pulldown (Medium-Wide Grip)
   → 3 × 8–12
   Cue: Chest up, slight lean, elbows to ribs
3. Chest-Supported Row (DB or Machine)
   → 3 × 8–12
   Cue: No momentum, squeeze shoulder blades
4. Single-Arm Cable Pulldown (IMPORTANT)
   → 3 × 10–12 each side
   Cue: Elbow to hip, slow and controlled

---

REAR DELTS / POSTURE
5. Face Pull
   → 3 × 12–15
6. Reverse Pec Deck / Rear Delt Fly
   → 2 × 12–15

---

BICEPS
7. EZ-Bar Curl or Close-Grip Supinated Pulldown
   → 3 × 8–12
8. Incline DB Curl or Hammer Curl
   → 3 × 10–12

---

Optional
- Hyperextensions → 2 × 15

---

RULES (IMPORTANT)
- No ego lifting
- Control every rep (2 sec down, 3 sec up)
- Full stretch at top, squeeze at bottom
- If you feel biceps more than back → reduce weight

---

FOCUS CUES
- “Elbows drive the movement”
- “Chest up = lats engaged”
- “Pull with back, not hands”

---

Progression (Weeks 1–6)
- Add reps or small weight every week

Deload (Weeks 7–8)
- Reduce weight by 40–50% OR cut sets in half

--------------------------------------------------

DAY 2 – LEGS

Mobility / Warm-up
- 90/90 Hip Stretch (Dynamic)
- Hip Flexor to Hamstring Flow
- Cossack Squats
- Single-Leg Glute Bridges (3 × 12)
- Standing Hip CARs

Main Lifts
1. Back Squat (4 × 6–8)
2. Romanian Deadlift (3–4 × 8–10)
3. Leg Press (3 × 10–12)
4. Bulgarian Split Squat (2–3 × 8–10 / leg)
5. Cable Hip Abduction
6. Leg Extension (2–3 × 12–15)
7. Leg Curl (2–3 × 12–15)
8. Hip Thrust

Calves / Tibialis
9. Standing Calf Raise (3–4 × 12–15)
10. Seated Calf Raise or Tibialis Raise (3 × 15–20)

--------------------------------------------------

DAY 3 – CHEST & TRICEPS

Warm-up / Activation
- Incline Push-Ups (2 × 15)
- Banded External Rotations (2 × 20)
- Light Air Punches (2 × 20 s)

Chest
1. Incline Barbell or DB Press (4 × 6–10)
2. Flat DB Press (3–4 × 8–12)
3. Chest Fly Machine or Low-to-High Cable Fly (3 × 12–15)
4. Dips (2–3 × 8–12) or cable high to low
5. Push-Up Finisher (1–2 sets close to failure)

Triceps
6. Rope Pushdown (3–4 × 10–15)
7. Overhead DB or Cable Extension (3 × 10–12)
8. Bench Dips (2 × 12–15)

--------------------------------------------------

DAY 4 – CORE & CONDITIONING

Warm-up
- Dead Bug (2 × 10)
- Cat-Cow (1 × 10)

Core
1. Farmer’s Walk or Suitcase Carry (3 × 30–40 s)
2. Cable Crunch (3 × 8–12)
3. Ab Wheel Rollout – Kneeling (3 × 6–12)
4. Pallof Press (3 × 10–12 / side)
5. Hanging Knee or Leg Raise (3 × 10–12)

Conditioning
- Incline Treadmill Walk (15–20 min)

Optional
- Neck Work – 2 movements × 2 sets

--------------------------------------------------

DAY 5 – SHOULDERS & BICEPS

Warm-up
- Band Pull-Apart (2 × 15)
- Dead Hang (2 × 20 s)
- Very Light Lateral Raises (1 × 20)

Shoulders
1. Overhead Press (BB or DB) (3 × 6–10)
2. Lateral Raise (3–4 × 12–15)
3. Reverse Fly or Face Pull (2–3 × 12–15)
4. Machine or DB Shoulder Press (2 × 10–12)
   *Add incline dumbbell press at 30 degrees*

Biceps
5. Close-Grip Pulldown (Palms Up) (3 × 8–12)
6. DB Preacher Curl or Hammer Curl (3 × 10–12)
7. 21s or High-Rep Pump Set (2 × 15–20)
